新闻与博客
客户的雄心正在加速我们的增长

blocks.text: 我们在两年半前刚刚推出 Sierra。本周，我们的 ARR 突破 4 亿美元，仅第三季度就新增超过 1.5 亿美元。这一个季度新增的 ARR，比我们去年全年创造的还要多。更重要的是，我们的增长还在加速：从 1 亿美元到 2 亿美元 ARR 用了六个月，而从 2 亿美元到 4 亿美元只用了五个月。

inlines.text: 我们在两年半前刚刚推出 Sierra。本周，我们的 ARR 突破 4 亿美元，仅第三季度就新增超过 1.5 亿美元。这一个季度新增的 ARR，比我们去年全年创造的还要多。更重要的是，我们的增长还在加速：从 1 亿美元到 2 亿美元 ARR 用了六个月，而从 2 亿美元到 4 亿美元只用了五个月。

blocks.text: 这一增长由多方面因素共同推动，包括：

inlines.text: 这一增长由多方面因素共同推动，包括：
客户雄心不断升级
——他们既是全球规模最大、监管最严的企业之一，也在推动智能体承担更多任务、更快落地。
智能体能力实现跃迁
——从一次性的客服对话，转向持续数周甚至数月、并能直接带动收入的互动。
借助 Ghostwriter 构建和优化智能体变得更容易
——本月，一家营收超过 400 亿美元的美国大型零售商从首次会面到智能体上线只用了 27 天。

blocks.text: 展望 2027 年，我们很高兴能帮助企业——目前财富 50 强中近 50% 已是我们的客户——回答它们面临的重大问题：如何把 AI 投入转化为可衡量的回报？个人智能体是机遇还是威胁？当所有人都能获得同样的智能时，我的竞争优势在哪里？

blocks.text: 我们的方法基于以下信念：

inlines.text: 我们的方法基于以下信念：
你为结果付费，而不是为消耗的 token 付费
——一笔贷款完成再融资、一笔保险理赔完成赔付、一笔销售成功签约、一位客户得以留存。
客户关系就是你的竞争优势
——借助 AI 智能体，客户关系会在每一次互动中加深，形成独属于你的上下文，并随时间不断累积增值。
你需要对个人智能体如何与你的品牌互动进行细粒度控制
——我们正在制定一项开放标准
Poppy
，与 Meta、Instinct、Rocket、Shopify、Stripe、Walmart 等 50 多家企业共同推动这一目标落地。

blocks.text: 所以，请把你们的难题交给我们。那些横跨三十次客户对话、耗时数周甚至数月、涉及多个系统、需要五十名员工开 Zoom 会议才能勉强理解、更别说解决的难题。这些正是 AI 为之而生的问题，也是 Sierra 团队乐于帮你解决的问题。

News & Blog
Our customers’ ambition is accelerating our growth

blocks.text: We launched Sierra just over two and a half years ago. This week, we hit $400M+ in ARR, adding over $150M+ in ARR in Q3 alone. That’s more ARR in one quarter than we generated all of last year. More importantly, our growth is accelerating: we took six months to double from $100M to $200M ARR, and only five months to double from $200M to $400M.

inlines.text: We launched Sierra just over two and a half years ago. This week, we hit $400M+ in ARR, adding over $150M+ in ARR in Q3 alone. That’s more ARR in one quarter than we generated all of last year. More importantly, our growth is accelerating: we took six months to double from $100M to $200M ARR, and only five months to double from $200M to $400M.

blocks.text: This growth is driven by a number of different factors, including:

inlines.text: This growth is driven by a number of different factors, including:
The increasing ambition of our customers
— while being some of the largest and most heavily regulated businesses in the world, they’re pushing to do more with their agents, faster.
A step change in what agents can do
— moving from one-and-done support conversations to interactions that last weeks or months and drive revenue.
The ease of building and improving agents with Ghostwriter
— this month a large US retailer ($40B+ in revenue) went from first meeting to live agent in 27 days.

blocks.text: Looking toward 2027, we’re excited to help businesses — we now work with almost 50% of the Fortune 50 — answer the big questions they’re facing. How do I turn our AI investments into measurable returns? Are personal agents an opportunity or a threat? What’s my competitive advantage when everyone has access to the same intelligence?

blocks.text: Our approach is grounded in the belief that:

inlines.text: Our approach is grounded in the belief that:
You pay for outcomes, not tokens used
— a loan refinanced, an insurance claim paid, a sale closed, a customer retained.
Your customer relationships are your competitive advantage
— with AI agents they deepen with every interaction, creating context that is uniquely yours and which compounds over time.
You need fine grained controls over how personal agents interact with your brand
— we’re developing an open standard,
Poppy
, with over 50 enterprises including Meta, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart to make this a reality.

blocks.text: So please bring us your hard problems. The ones that span thirty customer conversations, take weeks or months, involve multiple systems, and need fifty employees on a Zoom just to understand, let alone fix. Those are the problems AI was made for, and that our team at Sierra is excited to help you solve.
